verdict.rationale: Segment's Audiences docs say audiences can be built from computed traits and synced to hundreds of destinations, so the computed-trait half of the story is covered for targeting. Predictive scores (LTV, churn or purchase propensity) are not documented beyond a pricing-page line about "AI-powered audiences". missing for 10: documentation of how computed traits are defined and calculated on profiles, documented predictive scores (LTV, churn, purchase propensity), independent or hands-on corroboration.
